users.listed.head: Listed servers
users.listed.hint: These servers stand in this installation's trust list.
users.listed.nolist: The trust list is not here yet.
users.listed.none: No server stands in the trust list yet.
users.listed.addr.label: Change the address of {id}
users.listed.retire.label: Retire server {id}
users.listed.lastapi: The only API server of this installation cannot be retired. Take a further one in first.
users.addr.title: Change the address of “{id}”
users.addr.what: This installation will reach the server at the new address afterwards. The server's keys stay the same; only where it is to be found changes.
users.addr.form: The address looks like this: wss://name-of-the-server:7443/tunnel. An IPv4 address may stand instead of the name.
users.addr.only: Enter it only if the server is reachable at exactly this address.
users.addr.tellserver: Important: tell the server its new address itself too (on the server with ulh, entry ngc-api) and restart it. Otherwise the web server turns it away, because its certificate still names the old address.
users.addr.same: That is the address already entered. Nothing was changed.
users.addr.bad: That is not an address an API server is reachable at. It has to look like this: wss://name-of-the-server:7443/tunnel
users.addr.gone: This server no longer stands in the trust list.
users.addr.failed: The address could not be changed.
users.retire.title: Retire server “{id}”
users.retire.what: The server is taken out of this installation's trust list. Afterwards this installation no longer believes it and no longer connects to it.
users.retire.goeson: The server itself goes on running; its services do not stop. To take it in again it has to join anew.
users.retire.lastapi: That is the only API server of this installation. It cannot be retired, because the installation would not be reachable at all afterwards.
users.retire.failed: The server could not be retired.
